text:
maya: Quick heads-up from morning canary runs of nova-mini-q6 — mixed-orient subset shows a reproducible detok/token-boundary issue when vertical JP blocks include inline Arabic captions. small but consistent BLEU hit (~1.7) on that slice.
mei: can you paste one fail and the exact tokenizer + quant flags?
maya: sure. tokenizer=fast-v4, normalize=nfkc+ruby-preserve, quant=q6-hybrid, kernel=auto. failing input (serialized for model):
```
VERT_START
漢(かんじ)
CAPTION: بالبدا - short note
```
model expected detok: "Kanji (kanji) ... Caption: al-bada - short note"
model observed detok: "Kanji(かんじ)بالبدا - short note"
(mei: that looks like the ruby marker/token isn't being terminated with a neutral separator before the Arabic run)
sahil: any recent changes to ruby coalesce or bidi postprocess? we have a fast coalesce path in fast-v4 that tries to merge ruby into base token to reduce token count.
maya: yes we landed a micro-optimization last week that coalesces ruby spans at the end of tokenization when the following script is still 'common'. seems to misclassify some Arabic runs as common when vertical markers are present.
omar: interesting. i also want to check quant pipeline: we added an int-ish kernel that rewrites token ids in-place for faster detok. could that step be skipping an explicit separator insert?
mei: good call. i bisected quickly: repro fails when BOTH fast-v4 ruby-coalesce=true AND the q6 kernel token-rewrite path is enabled. either alone is ok.
eval-bot: quick metrics: mixed-orient vertical_jp_ar BLEU_base=34.2 -> BLEU_new=32.5, chrF 0.63 -> 0.61, token-boundary-errors +1.5%
sahil: short-term mitigation: disable ruby-coalesce in tokenizer config for canary OR disable token-rewrite kernel. which is faster to flip?
maya: toggling tokenizer config is easiest (no model re-push). can you flip ruby_coalesce=false for nova-mini-q6 canary?
deploy-bot: Received. Setting tokenizer.ruby_coalesce=false for nova-mini-q6 canary pool. Changes will roll out in ~90s. :gear:
mei: once rolled, i'll re-run the repro with --tokenizer-debug and post token-id + unicode streams.
omar: i'll audit the kernel token-rewrite codepath for places where we assume script continuity. if it mutates id buffers in-place it may not be inserting explicit separator tokens after special markers.
sahil: if rollback fixes it, let's add a unit test in tests/tokenizer_unit/test_vertical_ruby_mixedrtl.py that includes multiple variants (ruby+arabic, ruby+arabic+punctuation, ruby at EOL). Also add onboarding gate: "vertical+rtl smoke" to quant bring-up checklist.
maya: assigning: mei (repro + logs), omar (kernel audit), sahil (test + checklist PR). i'll open a ticket TICKET-ml-902 documenting the interplay and link to the repro output. tagging @eng-ml for visibility.
mei: running repro now, will paste diff in ~8m. :eyes:
maya: thanks — will update when canary finishes. :white_check_mark:
